description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'TextTrimmedFormatter' that implements a custom text formatter for trimming text to a specified length, used within Drupal's field formatting system.

classes.name: TextTrimmedFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal field formatter plugin that trims text content to a specified character limit, supporting summary display and custom settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the formatter, including trim length.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for the formatter, allowing configuration of trim length.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current settings for display.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable elements for each field item, applying trimming and summary logic.

methods.name: preRenderSummary
methods.description: Pre-render callback that trims the text to create a summary before rendering.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of callback methods that are trusted for rendering.
